title: Crop Video Editor: Trim & Cut
summary: Free video cropper & trimmer — crop, cut & resize video for Instagram & TikTok
description:
Cropzen is a free video cropper and video trimmer app — the fastest way to crop, trim, shorten and resize your videos right on your phone, in native quality with zero watermark.

Drop in any clip and reframe it for the feed you’re posting to. Pinch to zoom, drag to position, snap to a preset, and export. No timeline overwhelm, no sign-up, no uploads — your videos never leave your device.

CROP & REFRAME
• Freeform crop or lock to an aspect ratio
• Change the aspect ratio of any video in one tap
• One-tap presets: 9:16 Reels & Shorts, 1:1 feed, 4:5, 16:9 YouTube, TikTok
• Resize video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts
• Pinch-zoom, pan and straighten with a precise rotation wheel
• Rotate 90°, flip/mirror

TRIM, CUT & SHORTEN
• Frame-accurate video cutter and trimmer with a live filmstrip
• Lossless trim — cut and shorten clips without re-encoding, zero quality loss
• Set in/out points by dragging — see the exact frame you land on

MERGE & BATCH
• Merge videos — join several clips into one video and pick the canvas ratio
• Batch crop or compress several videos at once — same aspect ratio for every clip
• Video batch crop for a whole shoot instead of clip-by-clip editing

COMPRESS, GIF & AUDIO
• Video compressor — shrink file size to send on WhatsApp, Telegram or email
• Video to GIF converter in one tap
• Extract audio from video and save it as an audio file
• Round video message preset for Telegram — square crop, circle mask, 60 s cap

SPEED, REVERSE & MUTE
• Speed up video 2× or slow it down to 0.5×
• Reverse video
• Mute video — remove the sound in one tap

WATERMARK & BLUR
• Add watermark to video — your text or logo, in a corner, tiled or moving
• Blur part of a video — pixelate faces, plates or private details

EXPORT
• Native-quality MP4 export, no re-compression artifacts, no watermark
• Free: 1080p exports, no daily limit
• Pro: 4K exports

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% on-device processing — nothing is uploaded
• No account, no login

Perfect for creators posting to Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Stories who just want a clean, fast crop without a heavyweight editor.

Crop, trim and shorten your first video free — no sign-up, no watermark.

Cropzen Pro unlocks 4K export — a one-time lifetime purchase, or a monthly subscription if you prefer.
